claims.statement: Tev1 uses its language-model output head and a constrained option-letter response.

The two included independent evaluations describe different option-perturbation findings; protocol alignment is required before interpreting them as a contradiction.
No real model in the initial catalogue has been executed by this lab.
Novelty of all H001-H008 proposals is unverified.
